using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

    private ReservationValidator() { }

    public void Validate(ref ValidationContext ctx, global::Sample.Reservation value) {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value.Guest)) ctx.AddRequired("guest");
        else if (value.Guest is not null && (value.Guest.Length < 2 || value.Guest.Length > 40)) ctx.AddStringLength("guest", 2, 40);
